title: Choose the visual world for brickbot.ro (round 7)
question: Copy rewritten in a plain, modest first person: who we are, what we do, and that this season we reached the FIRST Championship (no more than that). The deal put Rain Garden first; Event Display beats it on both counts.

options.label: Rain Garden
options.lineage: a surreal garden where rain falls toward whatever its cloud is drawn to
options.thesis: A dark cloud of charge rains yellow down onto the students' photos: the team's energy falling on the people it reaches.
materials: photos as the ground the rain falls on
options.viewport: The wordmark, a plain intro and 'Partner with us' on the left; on the right a dark cloud rains yellow streaks down onto three student photos.
options.risk: Dreamy and a little sad (rain); it says energy weakly and could read as decoration.

raised.raise: Labels pinned to their subjects on leader lines, never floating captions.
The yellow appears only where something can actually be done.

options.label: Event Display
options.lineage: particle-collider event displays: tracks curving out of one collision
options.thesis: BrickBot as one collision of energy: yellow tracks curve out from the centre through detector rings to the students and the places this season reached.
materials: curved yellow tracks with faint secondary tracks
options.viewport: The wordmark, 'FTC team #15996, from "Unirea" National College in Focșani', two plain sentences and 'Partner with us' on the left. On the right, one bright centre with yellow tracks curving out to five photos (Nationals, drive team, Worlds, workshop, schools).
options.case: Beats the leader on both counts: electric energy is the structure, it shows impact spreading outward to real people and places, and it makes no claims.
options.risk: Scientific diagrams can feel cold; the photos must stay big, and the tracks stay flat with no glow.

options.label: Album Page
options.lineage: European clear-line comic albums: strict panel grid, yellow narration boxes
options.thesis: The season told as an album page: student photos as panels in a strict grid, each with a short factual yellow caption box.
options.viewport: Intro and wordmark on the left; four photo panels on the right, each captioned in a yellow box ('March 2026, Romania National Championship', 'The drive team, minutes before a match').
options.case: Warm and human, and the captions keep it factual. Less electric, and comics risk the childish look.

options.label: Tensegrity
options.thesis: Opposing forces holding a column rigid.
options.case: Declined: engineering metaphor without the people.

options.label: Warm App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground.
options.case: Declined: generic and off-brand (light and warm).
options.kept: Yellow only where you can act.

options.label: Algorave
options.case: Declined: the neon look you ruled out.
options.kept: Upcoming changes visible before they happen.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark team site with the wordmark and a yellow accent, built to the level of team254.com and citruscircuits.org.
canonCard.viewport: The team photo with the wordmark, a headline and two buttons, then the season, posts and sponsors.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other strong team's site.
